overview: Idea Forge is the earlier offline curated idea browser, separate from the later automatic IdeaForge CLI pipeline. It explores 36 authored mechanics across puzzle, action and strategy, with a concrete rule, loop, fun rationale, smallest prototype and design risk in each brief. A reproducible seed controls order while local history and favorites preserve ideas worth revisiting.
rules: Generate from 12 puzzle, 12 action and 12 strategy briefs; story is optional and off by default.
The same library never repeats an idea and reports exhaustion when no eligible ideas remain.
Previous/Next revisit history; Keep saves favorites and View Kept filters them.
Changing genres or restarting preserves the library; this utility creates briefs rather than complete games.
controls: Click buttons, or select with arrows/controller and activate with Space/controller A.
Up/Down jumps four buttons; Previous/Next, Keep and View Kept manage the library.
K saves a checkpoint; L loads it; Escape pauses. Progress also autosaves.
story: This is a design utility. Generated briefs may optionally include story, but the browser itself has no narrative campaign.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.

design.original_prompt: Create a utility that can create ideas for video games. Each idea must be centered on a totally unique, engaging, fun, and creative gameplay mechanic. There can be a story or not. It must be built in BlueEngine and published to BlueEngineGames once complete. Keep track of the issues with development to construct a robust feedback file for this game idea. Add this file to the BlueEngine repository so the game engine can improve on future runs
